links.outcome: Reproducibility of LLM responses to repeated identical questions, scored 1 to 3
links.effect: ChatGPT-5 had the highest mean reproducibility score, followed by Perplexity AI and Gemini 2.5; Microsoft Copilot had the lowest.
links.quote: ChatGPT-5 achieved significantly higher trust scores and showed the highest mean reproducibility score, followed by Perplexity AI and Gemini 2.5; Microsoft Copilot showed the lowest reproducibility.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the performance, safety (potential harm), and reproducibility of multiple large language models on consensus-based clinical questions regarding bone stress injuries using expert human ratings, but does not test a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
